## Où j'en suis
The SAML ACS endpoint for Fernhill is implemented. Assertion signatures are verified with signxml, and assertion conditions, replay protection (Redis) and a 120 s clock skew are checked. PR #412 is merged on GitHub, and the full suite passed (1284 passed, 3 skipped). What remains is Fernhill onboarding for the Thursday demo.

- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and send them Kestrel's staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD, for the Thursday 10:00 New York demo Maya requested
- [prochaine-étape] Create the separate ticket to enforce SSO and disable password login for Fernhill users
- [essai-raté] python3-saml on the Alpine base: the lxml and xmlsec libxml2 versions clash, and building lxml from source still failed on a missing crypto library
- [décision] Use signxml instead of python3-saml and remove xmlsec from the image (source: t08)
- [décision] Clock skew set to 120 s, per the Fernhill security questionnaire (source: t12)
- [décision] SSO enforcement and the password-login change stay out of this PR (source: t12)
